codeReview.summary: The feature substantially implements decision ledger emission and the admin decisions API with nested subagent trees, but the API parser is brittle and can fail on valid audit logs containing large non-decision events, breaking queryability.

issues.description: `readDecisionAuditFile` uses `bufio.Scanner` with default token size and returns `scanner.Err()` (line 175). Since audit logs include full tool results (`internal/tools/registry.go:206,228`), a >64KiB JSONL line can trigger `token too long`, causing `GET /api/admin/runs/{id}/decisions` to return 500 and violate the requirement that decisions remain queryable by run.
